Requirements: R-2, R-3, R-7
Plan row: TS-2

Obligations: OB-2-1

## Given
- A run-unique code datasource (`tc002-<random>`) created by the case and COMPLETED (P-pretty); deleted at the end. Baseline B0 (stamp) and U0 (update_date) read by raw GET.
- Oracle decision: Last indexed is the reindex TRIGGER time (person's S1 decision). AC-2 / Expected Result wording ("completed reindex operation") is an open PO documentation question and is NOT asserted.

## When
1. Trigger a manual full reindex (`full_reindex=true, skip_reindex=false`).
2. Poll at short intervals; the first read with status in-progress is the early read E.
3. Poll until COMPLETED, then read L (late read).

## Then
1. E shows `last_reindex_triggered_at` newer than B0 while the status is still in-progress. If the status was never seen in-progress (run too fast) the case is inconclusive, not green.
2. L equals E (completion does not move the stamp) and the stamp is earlier than L.update_date (completion time) of the run.

## Self-probe notes
- Discrimination: a completion-time implementation (the old behavior or reading A) shows B0 in E, so Then 1 fails; a stamp rewritten on completion fails Then 2.
- Early read is a separate GET during the run, independent of the trigger response; race with a fast reindex is reported inconclusive, never passed.
- The trigger-time implementation is the oracle and never a defect here.
- R-8 (update_date untouched) is an implementation-only claim and is not a Then; U0/update_date is read as information only (partition P-pretty).
